definitions.explanation: A particular but unspecified amount or level.

notes:
A compound of 一 (one) + 定 (fixed). Functions as a noun and no-adjective with two related senses: "fixed/constant" and "a certain amount."

SENSE 1 — FIXED/CONSTANT:
- {一定|いってい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧: to maintain a constant temperature
- {一定|いってい}している: is constant, is steady
- {一定|いってい}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: fixed period

SENSE 2 — CERTAIN/SOME:
- {一定|いってい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧: certain standards
- {一定|いってい}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧: above a certain level
- {一定|いってい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧: a certain degree of effect

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一定|いってい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: a fixed/certain ~
- {一定|いってい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧: to keep constant
- {一定|いってい}している: is stable/constant

USAGE:
When used with ⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧/⟦{以下|いか}→以下：01294_ika⟧, it means "above/below a certain threshold" — commonly seen in regulations and requirements.
